Alice: Quick heads-up — in the Node quickstart the X-Req-Id header is getting lost during auth retry and our logs show `requestId: undefined`. Repro steps below.
Ben: Which quickstart exactly?
Alice: `github.com/redwood-inference/quickstarts/node-telemetry` (branch: devex-telemetry). Steps:
```
npm ci
export NODE_ENV=dev
export LOG_LEVEL=debug
node sampleapp.js
curl -H \"X-Req-Id: 60be\" http://localhost:3000/predict
```
Logs show repeated attempts and then `requestId: undefined` on the retried call.
Carla: Sounds like the retry wrapper is creating a fresh request and not copying headers. We saw a similar pattern in an old infra bug.
Dave: Are OpenTelemetry hooks involved? We usually attach req id in a middleware that runs after auth.
Alice: Right — our express OTel middleware reads `req.get('X-Req-Id')` and adds it to the span and logger. But when the SDK does an auth-refresh retry it's issuing an internal fetch before the app-level middleware runs again.
Ben: So node fetch wrapper is the culprit? Python parity note: requests.Session keeps headers by default, so it doesn't reproduce there.
Carla: Quick workaround: preserve headers inside the SDK retry logic. e.g. in the wrapper do:
```
// pseudo
const preserveHeaders = (orig, next) => {
  next.headers = {...orig.headers, ...next.headers}
}
```
That ensures `X-Req-Id` survives.
Dave: Alternative: move req-id enrichment earlier (auth proxy) or stash it on `res.locals` so subsequent internal requests can see it.

Alice: I've opened PR #482 with a small fix to the fetch retry that copies headers and a unit test. Need a sanity check.
Ben: Looking. Also add a test that simulates auth refresh and asserts the header is still present.
Carla: There's also a redaction ordering quirk — the app redacts before enrichment sometimes, and then logs from downstream libs still leak the id. We should run redaction after span enrichment.
Dave: Agreed. Add an integration test that fuzzes logs and checks no `X-Req-Id` appears in plaintext post-redaction.
Alice: I'll update the quickstart README with a note to set `LOG_LEVEL=info` for onboarding to avoid noisy debug output that hides this problem.
Ben: Nice. Once PR lands please ping #devex so we can update the SDK changelog and the parity checklist for Python/Node.
Carla: Thanks — moving to patch review. :thumbsup:
